description: Opt-in GLM packed-research allocation on sm_121. Routed logical expert units and aggregate stacks retain the full legal research menu: Tessera E4M3 K1, Tessera BF16 K1, Tessera E2M1 K2 and plain BF16 source passthrough. This allocation restriction is not a serving qualification or export lane; per-unit context, shape and source-precision gates remain mandatory, routed E2M1 remains unqualified, and TP2 qualification is separate.

format_rules.detail: GLM packed research retains E4M3, BF16 and E2M1 Tessera routed rungs plus plain BF16 source passthrough. This is an allocation menu, not serving qualification: routed E2M1 and per-expert mixed rates remain unqualified, while the research-selected route supplies the separately gated E4M3/BF16 execution semantics.
